rationale.conceptual: The method uses standard MD/EAM techniques, but reproducing the exact amorphization thresholds requires correctly implementing Frenkel-pair creation, grouping, relaxation protocols, and elastic-constant calculations via fluctuation formulas; the multi-part algorithm and domain understanding (thermodynamic and structural criteria) make it non-trivial.

The orchestration of multiple simulation modes (single vs grouped defects), parameter extraction from a published potential, and careful state saving/analysis constitute a moderate multi-stage pipeline.
